Baby corn.d: Little ears blanched, then charred in butter on a hot flat-top. Crushed red pepper, lime zest and salt, with a wedge to squeeze.
Baby corn.note: Best eaten like corn on the cob.

Caviar on crackers.d: Salmon roe and snipped chives on crème fraîche over crisp water crackers, put together just before they go out.

Street cart hot dog.d: Simmered, then blistered on the griddle until the skin snaps. Steamed bun, yellow mustard, sauerkraut and onions stewed down with tomato.

Giant choc chip cookie.d: Brown-butter chocolate chip dough pressed into a pizza pan and baked soft in the middle. Piano keys piped across in white icing, cut at the table.

Chocolate egg cream.d: Syrup and cold milk in a tall glass, then seltzer poured hard from up high and stirred with a long spoon until a white head rises.
Chocolate egg cream.note: No egg, no cream. Never was.
